apps.name: notes
apps.title: Notes
apps.subtitle: Write things down
apps.about: Quick notes that sync to every device.

apps.name: tasks
apps.title: Tasks
apps.subtitle: Lists that get done
apps.about: A simple to-do list.

apps.name: recipes
apps.title: Recipes
apps.subtitle: Cook from what you have
apps.about: Save recipes and plan meals.

apps.name: photos
apps.title: Photos
apps.subtitle: Every picture, kept
apps.about: Your photos, backed up.

apps.name: budget
apps.title: Budget
apps.subtitle: Where the money goes
apps.about: Track spending by month.

apps.name: readlist
apps.title: Read List
apps.subtitle: Save it for later
apps.about: Articles to read later.

apps.name: timer
apps.title: Timer
apps.subtitle: Count down
apps.about: Simple timers.

apps.name: agents-md
apps.title: Agent Instructions
apps.subtitle: Rules for your AI
apps.about: The instructions and skills every AI tool on every device follows, like Claude Code and Codex, written in one place. Every change is kept, so you can go back.

requires.name: database
requires.title: Database
requires.why: to keep your instructions and skills

apps.name: agent-memory
apps.title: Agent Memory
apps.subtitle: One memory for all your AI
apps.about: Your AI remembers who you are, what you decided and what it tried, across every session, device and AI tool you use.

apps.name: agent-skills
apps.title: Agent Skills
apps.subtitle: Your AI's skills, on every device
apps.about: Gives the AI tools on your devices, like Claude Code and Codex, what they need to use your apps here, even when they aren't connected. It keeps them up to date as your apps change.

apps.name: ai-gateway
apps.title: AI Gateway
apps.subtitle: Every AI model in one place
apps.about: Use AI models on your own machines or online, all in one place. Add your AI keys once, and choose which model does which job.

apps.name: ai-usage
apps.title: AI Usage
apps.subtitle: What's left of your AI plans
apps.about: See what's left of each AI plan, like Claude and Codex, and whether it lasts until it resets.

apps.name: android-emulator
apps.title: Android Emulator
apps.subtitle: Android phones on your own machines
apps.about: Runs Android phones in Google's emulator on your own computers, to try apps and sites on. Watch and use one live from any device, and let your AI tap through it.

requires.name: webrtc
requires.title: WebRTC
requires.why: to show an emulator's screen live

apps.name: app-store
apps.title: App Store
apps.subtitle: Find, install and manage apps
apps.about: Every app your network can install, by what it's for, and what's installed for you, everyone and your groups: install, update, uninstall and bring back.

apps.name: apple-calendar
apps.title: Apple Calendar
apps.subtitle: Your Mac's calendar
apps.about: Your AI sees what's on in Apple Calendar, and adds, moves or deletes events, through your Mac.

apps.name: apple-contacts
apps.title: Apple Contacts
apps.subtitle: Your Mac's contacts
apps.about: Your AI finds anyone's number, email or address in Apple Contacts, through your Mac.

apps.name: apple-reminders
apps.title: Apple Reminders
apps.subtitle: Your Mac's reminders
apps.about: Your AI adds, changes and ticks off your Apple Reminders, through your Mac, so they're on your iPhone too.

apps.name: backups
apps.title: Backups
apps.subtitle: Copies of everything, kept safe
apps.about: Backs up your whole network, everyone's, to a disk on one of your machines or to cloud storage. Bring back anything you lost, or everything at once.

requires.name: database
requires.title: Database
requires.why: to keep where and when you back up

apps.name: chrome
apps.title: Chrome
apps.subtitle: A browser for your AI
apps.about: Gives your AI a Chrome of its own on your machine, signed in to nothing, to open pages, click and fill in forms. You can watch it as it goes.

requires.name: containers
requires.title: Containers
requires.why: to run each browser in a container

apps.name: chrome-profiles
apps.title: Chrome Profiles
apps.subtitle: Websites, signed in as you
apps.about: Lets your AI use websites as you, in Chrome profiles of yours such as Personal and Work. Sign in once, and it stays signed in.

requires.name: chrome
requires.title: Chrome
requires.why: to open a browser with a profile

requires.name: containers
requires.title: Containers
requires.why: to move a profile in and out of its browser

requires.name: database
requires.title: Database
requires.why: to save an update by itself once its time is up

apps.name: computer-use
apps.title: Computer Use
apps.subtitle: Your AI uses a screen
apps.about: Lets your AI see a screen and use it with clicks, typing and keys, for any app, not only web pages. You can watch what it does.

requires.name: sign-in
requires.title: Sign-In
requires.why: to name a phone as its person knows it

requires.name: webrtc
requires.title: WebRTC
requires.why: to show a computer's screen live

apps.name: containers
apps.title: Containers
apps.subtitle: Linux machines when you need one
apps.about: Starts Linux containers on your own machines: somewhere to install, build and try things without touching your devices.

requires.name: webrtc
requires.title: WebRTC
requires.why: to show a container's screen live

apps.name: database
apps.title: Database
apps.subtitle: Where apps keep their data
apps.about: Gives every app here a database of its own, so what it keeps for you is yours, and what it keeps for a group is the group's.

apps.name: server-load
apps.title: Device Activity
apps.subtitle: How busy your devices are
apps.about: See each device's memory, CPU, GPU and disk at a glance, with a widget for your Home Screen. Your AI uses it to pick a device with room for heavy work.

requires.name: database
requires.title: Database
requires.why: to keep whether each device is on its charger

apps.name: encryption
apps.title: Encryption
apps.subtitle: Data only you can read
apps.about: Encrypts what your apps keep, so whoever stores your network's data can't read it. Your Vault is kept this way.

apps.name: git-repos
apps.title: Git Repos
apps.subtitle: Code, kept in your network
apps.about: Git hosting of your own: repos for you, your groups or everyone, with branches, history and pull requests, on every device you use.

apps.name: gmail
apps.title: Gmail
apps.subtitle: Your Gmail, for you and your AI
apps.about: Your AI searches, reads, labels and drafts email in all your Gmail accounts. It sends one only when you ask.

apps.name: google-account
apps.title: Google Account
apps.subtitle: Sign in to Google once
apps.about: Signs your Google accounts in to Gmail, Google Calendar, Drive, Docs and Sheets, and out again. Each account you add is yours alone.

apps.name: google-calendar
apps.title: Google Calendar
apps.subtitle: Your Google calendars
apps.about: Your AI sees what's on across your Google calendars, and adds, moves or cancels events when you ask.

apps.name: google-docs
apps.title: Google Docs
apps.subtitle: Your Google Docs
apps.about: Your AI reads your Google Docs, writes in them and makes new ones.

apps.name: google-drive
apps.title: Google Drive
apps.subtitle: Your Drive files
apps.about: Your AI finds, uploads, renames, moves and trashes files in your Google Drive.

apps.name: google-sheets
apps.title: Google Sheets
apps.subtitle: Your Google Sheets
apps.about: Your AI reads your spreadsheets, adds rows, changes cells and makes new ones.

apps.name: home-screen
apps.title: Home Screen
apps.subtitle: Your pages of apps
apps.about: Your Home Screen, everyone's and your groups': pages of apps and widgets, arranged your way, and an App Library of every app you can reach, by category.

apps.name: imessage
apps.title: iMessage
apps.subtitle: Your Mac's texts
apps.about: Your AI reads and searches your iMessages and texts, and sends one when you ask, through your Mac.

apps.name: inspector
apps.title: Inspector
apps.subtitle: Your AI checks an app's screen
apps.about: Lets your AI read an app's screen on your devices as a test would, and tap, type and take pictures of it, to check it works.

apps.name: iphone-simulator
apps.title: iPhone Simulator
apps.subtitle: iPhones on your Mac
apps.about: Runs iPhones in Xcode's Simulator on your Mac, to try apps and sites on. Watch and use one live from any device, and let your AI tap through it.

requires.name: webrtc
requires.title: WebRTC
requires.why: to show a simulator's screen live

apps.name: messenger
apps.title: Messenger
apps.subtitle: Your Messenger chats
apps.about: Your AI reads and searches your Facebook Messenger chats, and sends a message when you ask.

apps.name: notifications
apps.title: Notifications
apps.subtitle: Alerts on all your devices
apps.about: Notifications from your apps and your AI, on every device you use, kept in your inbox until you clear them. Choose which apps may notify you.

requires.name: encryption
requires.title: Encryption
requires.why: to encrypt what's sent to your devices

apps.name: permissions
apps.title: Permissions
apps.subtitle: Who can see and change what
apps.about: Share what you make with people, groups or a link, and choose who can see or change it. Make groups for your family or team.

requires.name: database
requires.title: Database
requires.why: to keep who may reach what

apps.name: soft-delete
apps.title: Recently Deleted
apps.subtitle: Restore what you deleted
apps.about: Keeps what's deleted for 30 days, then deletes it for good. Restore anything before then, even an app you uninstalled, with what it kept.

requires.name: database
requires.title: Database
requires.why: to keep what you deleted for 30 days

apps.name: remote-shell
apps.title: Remote Shell
apps.subtitle: Run commands on your devices
apps.about: Lets your AI run a command on one of your own devices, from anywhere. Every command is logged on the device it ran on.

apps.name: sandbox
apps.title: Sandbox
apps.subtitle: Apps you don't know, kept apart
apps.about: Runs apps you don't fully trust walled off from your machines, with only what you let them have, so anyone can try one without a server of their own.

apps.name: screen-sharing
apps.title: Screen Sharing
apps.subtitle: Your AI uses your Mac's screen
apps.about: Lets your AI see your Mac's screen and use its mouse and keyboard, as you would, through Computer Use, while you watch. Only you, and your network's owner, can use your Mac's screen.

apps.name: server-debug
apps.title: Server Debug
apps.subtitle: Look inside a running app
apps.about: For developers: read an app's debug logs, see what it's running and trace it live on your servers, when it goes wrong and the error doesn't say why.

apps.name: settings
apps.title: Settings
apps.subtitle: Every app's settings, in one place
apps.about: Your devices, people, accounts, notifications, look and updates, and every app you have, in one place. Each app brings its own settings here.

apps.name: sign-in
apps.title: Sign-In
apps.subtitle: People, devices and passkeys
apps.about: Invite people to your network, who sign in with a passkey or Google and no password. See and remove your devices and the AI assistants you let in.

apps.name: stay-awake
apps.title: Stay Awake
apps.subtitle: Keep a Mac online
apps.about: Keeps a Mac awake while it's plugged in, even with its lid shut, so your other devices and your AI can reach it. On battery it sleeps as usual.

apps.name: telemetry
apps.title: Telemetry
apps.subtitle: What's slow, failing or costly
apps.about: Shows what's failing or slow in your network, and what AI costs, for the last 14 days. It keeps names and timings, never what anyone wrote.

requires.name: database
requires.title: Database
requires.why: to keep its schedule and its alerts

apps.name: vault
apps.title: Vault
apps.subtitle: Passwords and keys, kept safe
apps.about: Keeps your passwords, keys and sign-ins, and lets your apps and your AI use them without ever seeing them. You choose who may use each one.

requires.name: encryption
requires.title: Encryption
requires.why: to keep your secrets from whoever runs the bucket

requires.name: notifications
requires.title: Notifications
requires.why: to tell you when an agent saves something to your Vault

apps.name: webrtc
apps.title: WebRTC
apps.subtitle: Live video of your screens
apps.about: Shows the screens your apps open, like a browser you sign in on or your AI's desktop, as smooth live video you can click and type on, through Cloudflare's relays.

requires.name: vault
requires.title: Vault
requires.why: to use your Cloudflare TURN key

apps.name: whatsapp
apps.title: WhatsApp
apps.subtitle: Your WhatsApp chats
apps.about: Your AI reads and searches your WhatsApp chats, and sends a message when you ask. Link your phone to one of your devices, as you would WhatsApp Desktop.

apps.name: tasks
apps.why: Its files couldn't be fetched from example.com.
